About
Vel Tech provides a reliable and convenient transportation facility to support the daily commuting needs of students and staff. Our transport network connects the university campus with various locations across Chennai and its surrounding areas, making travel to and from the campus convenient and accessible.
The university operates a fleet of buses covering multiple routes and strategically located boarding points. The transport service is designed with a focus on
safety, punctuality, comfort, and convenience
, ensuring a smooth commuting experience for the Vel Tech community.
Students can access the available routes, boarding points, and transport-related information through the university’s
Transport Management System
, which also enables convenient online transport booking.
With well-organized routes and a technology-enabled booking process, Vel Tech’s transport facility aims to provide students with a
safe, efficient, and hassle-free commuting experience
throughout their academic journey.
